title: Representations of numeric blank answers
---

Valores numéricos do Brasil: [^v0], [^v1], [^v2], [^v3], [^v4], [^v5], [^v6], [^v7], [^v8], [^v9], [^v10], [^v11].

[^v0/numeric]: -1

[^v1/numeric]: -0

[^v2/numeric]: +390000000000

[^v3/numeric]: +3/4

[^v4/numeric]: 4/2

[^v5/numeric]: 0.25

[^v6/numeric]: 0.1

[^v7/numeric]: +3.14

[^v8/numeric]: 3000000000.5

[^v9/numeric]: 2.0

[^v10/numeric]: -0.0

[^v11/numeric]: 0.
